Title: Azure Blob lifecycle management is now available in all Azure regions

Body.Content:
Azure Blob lifecycle management offers a rich, rule-based policy for your unstructured data. You can use the policy to transition your data to the appropriate access tiers or to expire your data at the end of its lifecycle.  

This release includes the following improvements:

  • Expanded regional availability which includes Azure Government, Azure China, and Azure Germany
  • Improved portal experience with a wizard-based policy rule management

Read more about managing the Azure Blob storage lifecycle.
